market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$81,286, needs to dip to $45,000 by Dec 31, 2026 — that is a -45% drawdown over ~8 months. Such a drop is rare without a major macro/crypto shock; the broader trend is recovery. Historical base rate for >40% drawdowns from current levels in 8 months is low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Black-swan macro event or regulatory crackdown could trigger a deep crash
